field_semantics.delta: Maximum influence_rubric_mass among the directly targeted units; used only as a question-impact proxy.
field_semantics.should_ask: Post-run design audit of whether material uncertainty remained at the moment of asking.
field_semantics.answer_usable: yes, partial, limited, or no based on whether the persona-bounded answer can constrain a deliverable decision.
field_semantics.reflected: yes, partial, or no based on answer-to-report uptake, not mere topic mention.

questions.question: What content directions do you most want to pursue?
questions.context_evidence: No personal direction was visible in instruction-only; the hidden persona contained AI application cases, industry trends, and entrepreneurship.
questions.answer_summary: AI, AI application cases, industry trends, and entrepreneurship experience.

questions.question: Whom do you primarily want to attract?
questions.context_evidence: Neither instruction-only nor the hidden persona contained an explicit audience choice; the persona only offered founder and professional-network proxies.

questions.question: Which production formats suit you best?
questions.context_evidence: Neither the instruction nor persona specified on-camera, voice-over, text, screen-recording, podcast, vlog, or AI-assisted production preferences.

questions.question: How much time can you invest each week?
questions.context_evidence: Instruction-only exposed no time facts; the persona contained weekday-morning creativity and family weekends but not weekly hours.
questions.answer_summary: Prefer weekday mornings and reserve weekends for family; weekly total unspecified.

questions.question: What budget can you accept during the first three to six months?
questions.context_evidence: Instruction-only exposed no budget; the persona contained cost-effectiveness but no creator-project budget.
questions.answer_summary: No fixed budget; prioritize cost-effectiveness and ROI.

questions.question: How do you rank follower growth, professional influence, leads, ad revenue, products/services, long-term brand, and business traffic?
questions.context_evidence: The task stated brand building, a stable audience, and optional monetization but no full goal hierarchy or company use.
questions.answer_summary: Long-term personal brand > professional influence; no clear ranking for remaining goals.

questions.question: How do you rank AI influence, company lead generation/founder brand, personal income, independent media/IP, and fundraising/recruiting/industry-resource goals?
questions.context_evidence: The full persona established an AI-company founder but not how this account should serve the company or how the offered goals should be ranked.
questions.answer_summary: No strong ranking beyond the goals already stated.

questions.question: How many hours per week will you invest, and can team members assist with editing, operations, or research?
questions.context_evidence: The persona already supplied morning creativity and family weekends but not weekly hours or team assistance.
questions.answer_summary: Morning/weekend pattern restated; weekly hours and team assistance remain unspecified.

questions.question: What budget will you invest during the first three months?
questions.context_evidence: The persona established cost-effectiveness and purchasing power but did not allocate a creator-project budget.
questions.answer_summary: No fixed budget; reasonable ROI required.

questions.question: How comfortable are you appearing on camera?
questions.context_evidence: The full persona contained no creator-format or on-camera preference.

questions.question: Which audience do you most want to influence?
questions.context_evidence: Founder, technical, and networking proxies were visible, but no explicit audience choice existed.
questions.answer_summary: No strong preference; infer it from the persona.

full_persona_verdict.interpretation: All five questions targeted values absent from the supplied persona. Their low information yield is due to persona under-specification, not over-asking. Some broad questions also elicited already-known schedule or ROI facts, but their decision target was the missing hours/delegation or budget ceiling.
